name: run_date
description: The dt the run processed. Partition key. A backfill writes an older value, so use etl_ts for wall-clock ordering.

name: dag_run_id
description: Airflow run id, so a retry's rows are distinguishable from the original attempt's.

name: layer
description: raw | stage | core. Qualifies metric_name, which is why names like row_count need no layer prefix.

name: metric_name
description: Stable slug, unique within a layer, e.g. dedup_dropped.

name: metric_value
description: Exact decimal value. NUMERIC rather than FLOAT64 so counts and rates are exact and render as plain decimals -- FLOAT64 shows values above ~1e9 in scientific notation. Timestamp-valued measurements are stored as Unix epoch seconds, so this is the only value column.

name: etl_ts
description: UTC time the measurement was taken. Same meaning as etl_ts on stage and core.
